back to a meromorphic section of `f^* F`: apply the morphism `𝒦_Y(F) ⟶ f_* 𝒦_X(f^* F)` and
read the resulting global section over the whole of `X`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pullbackMeromorphicSection (s : MeromorphicSection Y.sheaf F) :
    MeromorphicSection X.sheaf
      ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullback f.toShHom).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isRegularMeromorphicSection_pullbackMeromorphicSection_of_isInvertible
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 02OY part (2).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of locally ringed spaces for which
pullbacks of meromorphic functions are defined and let `L` be an invertible `𝒪_Y`-module. The
pullback of a regular meromorphic section of `L` is a regular meromorphic section of `f^* L`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRegularMeromorphicSection_pullbackMeromorphicSection_of_isInvertible
    {X Y : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : PullbacksMeromorphicSections f)
    (L : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf)
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible Y.presheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.property L)
    (s : MeromorphicSection Y.sheaf L) (hs : IsRegularMeromorphicSection Y.sheaf L s) :
    IsRegularMeromorphicSection X.sheaf
      ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullback f.toShHom).obj L)
      (pullbackMeromorphicSection f hf L s)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isRegularMeromorphicSection_of_isIntegral
declarations.doc: An invertible sheaf of modules on an integral scheme has a regular meromorphic section.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isRegularMeromorphicSection_of_isIntegral
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj X.ringCatSheaf.property F] :
    ∃ s : MeromorphicSection X.sheaf F, IsRegularMeromorphicSection X.sheaf F s

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isRegularMeromorphicSection_of_isReduced
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 02OZ, part (2).** An invertible sheaf of modules on a reduced scheme every
quasi-compact open of which has finitely many irreducible components has a regular meromorphic
section.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isRegularMeromorphicSection_of_isReduced (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsReduced X]
    (hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite)
    (L : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj X.ringCatSheaf.property L] :
    ∃ s : MeromorphicSection X.sheaf L, IsRegularMeromorphicSection X.sheaf L s

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isRegularMeromorphicSection_of_noEmbeddedPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 02OZ, part (3).** An invertible sheaf of modules on a locally Noetherian scheme
without embedded points has a regular meromorphic section.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isRegularMeromorphicSection_of_noEmbeddedPoints (X : Scheme.{u})
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hX : HasNoEmbeddedPoints X) (L : X.Modules)
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj X.ringCatSheaf.property L] :
    ∃ s : MeromorphicSection X.sheaf L, IsRegularMeromorphicSection X.sheaf L s

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isRegularMeromorphicSection_of_hasNoEmbeddedPoints
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0EMI]**, which is case (3) of [Stacks, Tag 02OZ]. An invertible sheaf of
modules on a locally Noetherian scheme without embedded points has a regular meromorphic
section.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isRegularMeromorphicSection_of_hasNoEmbeddedPoints (X : Scheme.{u})
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hX : HasNoEmbeddedPoints X) (L : X.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 L] :
    ∃ s : MeromorphicSection X.sheaf L, IsRegularMeromorphicSection X.sheaf L s
declarations.comment: case (3), X locally Noetherian without embedded points

declarations.name: Stacks.DenominatorIdeal.denominatorIdeal_sections
declarations.doc:
A section of the structure sheaf is a denominator of the meromorphic section `s` exactly when
its product with `s` is a section of `L`.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdeal_sections (U : Opens X)
    (f : (SheafOfModules.unit (O X)).val.obj (op U)) :
    (∃ d : (denominatorIdeal X L s).val.obj (op U),
      (denominatorIdealι X L s).val.app (op U) d = f) ↔
    (∃ t : L.val.obj (op U),
      (sectionMap X L s).val.app (op U) f =
        (toK X L).val.app (op U) t)

declarations.name: Stacks.DenominatorIdeal.denominatorIdeal_section_mono
declarations.doc: Multiplication by a regular meromorphic section embeds its denominator ideal in `L`.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdeal_section_mono (hs : IsRegularMeromorphicSection X.sheaf L s) :
    Mono (denominatorIdealMul X L s)

declarations.name: Stacks.DenominatorIdealInvertible.denominatorIdeal_inclusion_mono
declarations.doc:
**The denominator ideal of a meromorphic section of an invertible sheaf embeds in the
structure sheaf.** Stacks Tag 02P0, "inclusion is injective".
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdeal_inclusion_mono (s : MeromorphicSection.{u, u} X.sheaf L)
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf (O X).property L) :
    Mono (denominatorIdealι X L s)

declarations.name: Stacks.DenominatorIdealQcoh.denominatorIdeal_isQuasicoherent
declarations.doc:
**The denominator ideal of a meromorphic section of an invertible sheaf is quasi-coherent.**

Around every point there is an affine open `V` on which the denominator ideal is the colon ideal
`(b Γ(X, V) : a)` for a nonzerodivisor `b` and a numerator `a`, and the colon ideal commutes with
localization, so the sections over each basic open of `V` are the localization of the sections
over `V`.  Those affine opens cover `X`, and quasi-coherence is detected by that condition on the
members of a cover.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdeal_isQuasicoherent
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf (O X).property L) :
    (denominatorIdeal X L s).IsQuasicoherent

declarations.name: Stacks.DenominatorIdealQcoh.denominatorIdealData_ideal
declarations.doc:
**On each affine open the ideal-sheaf data are exactly the denominators.**

`Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdeals` is a supremum and in general shrinks the family of ideals it is
applied to; it does not here, because quasi-coherence of the denominator ideal makes that family
compatible with passage to a basic open, so it is already an ideal sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdealData_ideal
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf (O X).property L)
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (denominatorIdealData X L s).ideal U =
      ((denominatorIdealι X L s).val.app (op U.1)).hom.range

declarations.name: Stacks.DenominatorIdealQcoh.denominatorIdealData_support_isNowhereDense
declarations.doc:
**The closed support of the denominator ideal is nowhere dense.**

Around every point of every open set there is an affine open carrying a nonzerodivisor `b` which
is a denominator of `s`, so `(b) ⊆ I` there and the support is contained in `V(b)`, which has
empty interior.  Shrinking freely is legitimate because the nowhere-density argument runs on an
affine open of its own choosing inside the interior of the support.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdealData_support_isNowhereDense
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf (O X).property L) :
    IsNowhereDense ((denominatorIdealData X L s).support : Set X)

declarations.name: Stacks.DenominatorCokernel.denominatorIdeal_inclusion_support
declarations.doc:
**The cokernel of the inclusion of the denominator ideal in the structure sheaf is supported
on a closed nowhere dense subset.**
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdeal_inclusion_support
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf (O X).property L) :
    ∃ T : Set X, IsClosed T ∧ IsNowhereDense T ∧
      (asModuleSheaf X (cokernel (denominatorIdealι X L s))).supp ⊆ T

declarations.name: Stacks.DenominatorCokernel.denominatorIdeal_section_support
declarations.doc:
**The cokernel of multiplication by a regular meromorphic section of an invertible sheaf is
supported on a closed nowhere dense subset.**  Stacks Tag 02P0, "support of the second
cokernel".
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdeal_section_support
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf (O X).property L)
    (hs : IsRegularMeromorphicSection X.sheaf L s) :
    ∃ T : Set X, IsClosed T ∧ IsNowhereDense T ∧
      (asModuleSheaf X (cokernel (denominatorIdealMul X L s))).supp ⊆ T

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_denominatorIdeal_inclusion_app_eq_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02P0**, the denominator rule. A section `f` of `𝒪_X` over `V` lies in
the ideal of denominators of a meromorphic section `s` of `L` exactly when `f s` is a section
of `L` over `V`; here "lies in the ideal" means that `f` is the image of a section of the fibre
product under the ideal inclusion, and "`f s` is a section of `L`" means that `f s` is the
image of a section of `L` under the canonical map `L ⟶ K_X(L)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_denominatorIdeal_inclusion_app_eq_iff
    (L : SheafOfModules.{u}
      (Stacks.Sheaves.Differentials.ringSheaf (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.sheaf))
    (s : MeromorphicSection X.sheaf L) (V : Opens X)
    (f : (SheafOfModules.unit
      (Stacks.Sheaves.Differentials.ringSheaf (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.sheaf)).val.obj
        (op V)) :
    (∃ d : (denominatorIdeal X L s).val.obj (op V),
      (denominatorIdealι X L s).val.app (op V) d = f) ↔
    (∃ t : L.val.obj (op V),
      (meromorphicSectionMul X L s).val.app (op V) f =
        (toMeromorphicSectionSheafAsModule X L).val.app (op V) t)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdeal_section_mono
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02P0**, injectivity of multiplication by the section. For a regular
meromorphic section `s` of `L`, multiplication by `s` embeds the ideal of denominators of `s`
in `L`.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdeal_section_mono
    (L : SheafOfModules.{u}
      (Stacks.Sheaves.Differentials.ringSheaf (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.sheaf))
    (s : MeromorphicSection X.sheaf L)
    (_hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj
      (Stacks.Sheaves.Differentials.ringSheaf (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.sheaf).property
        L)
    (hs : IsRegularMeromorphicSection X.sheaf L s) :
    Mono (denominatorIdealMul X L s)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdeal_inclusion_mono
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02P0**, injectivity of the ideal inclusion. For an invertible sheaf of
modules `L` and a meromorphic section `s` of `L`, the ideal of denominators of `s` embeds in the
structure sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdeal_inclusion_mono
    (L : SheafOfModules.{u}
      (Stacks.Sheaves.Differentials.ringSheaf (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.sheaf))
    (s : MeromorphicSection X.sheaf L)
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj
      (Stacks.Sheaves.Differentials.ringSheaf (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.sheaf).property
        L) :
    Mono (denominatorIdealι X L s)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealData_ideal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02P0**, the affine denominator ideal. For an invertible sheaf of
modules `L` and a meromorphic section `s` of `L`, the component of
`AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealData` at an affine open `U` is exactly the range of the
inclusion of the ideal of denominators on sections over `U`: assembling the ideal sheaf from
those ranges by `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdeals` does not shrink any of
them.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdealData_ideal
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj
      (Stacks.Sheaves.Differentials.ringSheaf (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.sheaf).property
        L)
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (denominatorIdealData X L s).ideal U =
      ((denominatorIdealι X L s).val.app (op U.1)).hom.range

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealData_support_isNowhereDense
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02P0**, the support of the ideal of denominators. For an invertible
sheaf of modules `L` and a meromorphic section `s` of `L`, the support of
`AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealData` is a nowhere dense subset of `X`.

It is contained in the complement of the union, over the points of `X`, of the part of the
affine neighbourhood produced by
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isAffineOpen_nhds_isNowhereDense_denominator` on which the denominator
`b` found there is invertible: on an affine open inside such a set the ideal inclusion is
surjective on sections, so by `AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealData_ideal` the component of
the ideal sheaf there is the unit ideal and its zero locus contains no point of that open. The
union is dense because the vanishing locus of a nonzerodivisor on an affine open is nowhere
dense, so its complement is nowhere dense.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdealData_support_isNowhereDense
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj
      (Stacks.Sheaves.Differentials.ringSheaf (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.sheaf).property
        L) :
    IsNowhereDense ((denominatorIdealData X L s).support : Set X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdeal_isQuasicoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02P0**, quasi-coherence of the ideal of denominators. For an
invertible sheaf of modules `L` and a meromorphic section `s` of `L`, the ideal of denominators
of `s` is a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals.

Quasi-coherence is checked by the localization criterion on the affine opens contained in the
neighbourhoods of `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isAffineOpen_nhds_denominator_numerator_isUnit`,
which cover `X`. There the sections of the ideal are cut out by the colon condition
`f · a ∈ (b)` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_denominatorIdeal_inclusion_app_eq_iff_mul_eq_of_le`, and a colon
condition localizes by `AlgebraicGeometry.isLocalizedModule_restrictₗ_of_colon`. Regularity of
`s` is not used: the source assumes it throughout Tag 02P0, but of its conclusions only
injectivity of multiplication by `s` and the support of that map's cokernel need it.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdeal_isQuasicoherent
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj
      (Stacks.Sheaves.Differentials.ringSheaf (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.sheaf).property
        L) :
    (denominatorIdeal X L s).IsQuasicoherent

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdeal_inclusion_support
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02P0**, the support of the first cokernel. For an invertible sheaf of
modules `L` and a meromorphic section `s` of `L`, the cokernel of the inclusion of the ideal of
denominators of `s` in the structure sheaf is supported on a closed nowhere dense subset.

The set is the complement of the union, over the points of `X`, of the part of the affine
neighbourhood produced by
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isAffineOpen_nhds_isNowhereDense_denominator` on which the
denominator `b` found there is invertible. On each such open set the whole structure sheaf
consists of denominators, because `b` lies in the ideal and is a unit, so the cokernel has no
sections there; and the union is dense because the vanishing locus of a nonzerodivisor on an
affine open is nowhere dense.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdeal_inclusion_support
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj
      (Stacks.Sheaves.Differentials.ringSheaf (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.sheaf).property
        L) :
    ∃ T : Set X, IsClosed T ∧ IsNowhereDense T ∧
      (⟨(cokernel (denominatorIdealι X L s)).val,
        (cokernel (denominatorIdealι X L s)).isSheaf⟩ :
          RingedSpace.ModuleSheaf.{u} X.toRingedSpace).supp ⊆ T

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdeal_section_support
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02P0**, the support of the second cokernel. For an invertible sheaf of
modules `L` and a *regular* meromorphic section `s` of `L`, the cokernel of multiplication by
`s` on the ideal of denominators of `s` is supported on a closed nowhere dense subset.

The set is the complement of the union, over the points of `X`, of the part of the affine
neighbourhood produced by
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isAffineOpen_nhds_denominator_numerator` on which the numerator `a`
found there is invertible. On each such open set every section of `L` is `d · s` for a
denominator `d`, because `L` is generated by `g` and `b · s = a · g` with `a` a unit; and the
union is dense because `a` is a nonzerodivisor
(`AlgebraicGeometry.numerator_mem_nonZeroDivisors`, which is where regularity of `s` enters)
and the vanishing locus of a nonzerodivisor on an affine open is nowhere dense.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdeal_section_support
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj
      (Stacks.Sheaves.Differentials.ringSheaf (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.sheaf).property
        L)
    (hs : IsRegularMeromorphicSection X.sheaf L s) :
    ∃ T : Set X, IsClosed T ∧ IsNowhereDense T ∧
      (⟨(cokernel (denominatorIdealMul X L s)).val,
        (cokernel (denominatorIdealMul X L s)).isSheaf⟩ :
          RingedSpace.ModuleSheaf.{u} X.toRingedSpace).supp ⊆ T

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdeal
declarations.doc:
The sheaf of denominators of a meromorphic section, as the fibre product of the structure
sheaf and `L` over `K_X(L)`. Its sections over `V` are the pairs `(f, t)` with `f s = t` in
`K_X(L)(V)`, so the image of its first projection is `{f ∈ 𝒪_X(V) | f s ∈ L(V)}`.
declarations.statement:
def denominatorIdeal
    (L : SheafOfModules.{u}
      (Stacks.Sheaves.Differentials.ringSheaf (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.sheaf))
    (s : MeromorphicSection X.sheaf L) :
    SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.Sheaves.Differentials.ringSheaf (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      X.sheaf)
declarations.comment: the ideal sheaf of denominators of `s`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealSmul
declarations.doc:
The product `I · F` of the ideal of denominators of `s` and the module `F`: the image of the
action of `I` on `F`.
declarations.statement: def denominatorIdealSmul : X.Modules
declarations.comment: the product of the denominator ideal and the module

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealSmulι
declarations.doc: The first canonical map, the inclusion `I · F ⟶ F`.
declarations.statement: def denominatorIdealSmulι : denominatorIdealSmul X L F s ⟶ F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealBadLocus_isClosed
declarations.doc:
The exceptional subset is closed.

Both cokernels are quotients of modules of finite type — the structure sheaf and the invertible
sheaf `L`, both coherent on a locally Noetherian scheme — so both supports are closed.

Regularity of `s` is not used: the source assumes it throughout Tag 02P2, but of the
exceptional subset's two properties only nowhere denseness needs it.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdealBadLocus_isClosed [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj
      X.ringCatSheaf.property L) :
    IsClosed (denominatorIdealBadLocus X L s)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealBadLocus_isNowhereDense
declarations.doc:
The exceptional subset is nowhere dense: each of its two pieces is contained in a closed
nowhere dense subset by [Stacks, Tag 02P0].
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdealBadLocus_isNowhereDense
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj
      X.ringCatSheaf.property L)
    (hs : IsRegularMeromorphicSection X.sheaf L s) :
    IsNowhereDense (denominatorIdealBadLocus X L s)
declarations.comment: the exceptional subset is nowhere dense

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealSmul_inclusion_mono
declarations.doc:
The first canonical map is injective: it is the inclusion of the image of the action map,
hence the kernel of a cokernel projection.
declarations.statement: theorem denominatorIdealSmul_inclusion_mono : Mono (denominatorIdealSmulι X L F s)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealSmul_inclusion_support
declarations.doc:
The cokernel of the first canonical map is supported on the exceptional subset.

Off the support of `𝒪_X / I` the stalk map of the ideal inclusion is surjective; tensoring with
`F` and composing with the left unit constraint keeps it so, and the action map factors through
`I · F`, so the stalk map of the inclusion `I · F ⟶ F` is surjective there as well.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdealSmul_inclusion_support :
    SheafOfModules.supp (cokernel (denominatorIdealSmulι X L F s)) ⊆
      denominatorIdealBadLocus X L s

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealSmulMul
declarations.doc:
**The second canonical map `I · F ⟶ F ⊗ L`**, multiplication by the meromorphic section on
the product `I · F`, together with the identity characterising it: its composite with the
factorisation of the action map through its image is multiplication by `s` on `I ⊗ F`. Since that
factorisation is an epimorphism the identity determines the map, so this is the canonical map and
not an arbitrary one.
declarations.statement:
def denominatorIdealSmulMul [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj
      X.ringCatSheaf.property L)
    (hs : IsRegularMeromorphicSection X.sheaf L s)
    [F.IsCoherent] (hF : AlgebraicGeometry.HasNoEmbeddedAssociatedPoints F)
    (hSupp : SheafOfModules.supp F = Set.univ) :
    { f : denominatorIdealSmul X L F s ⟶ Scheme.Modules.tensorObj F L //
      Abelian.factorThruImage (denominatorIdealTensorAction X L F s) ≫ f =
        denominatorIdealTensorMul X L F s }

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealSmulMul_mono
declarations.doc:
The second canonical map is injective: the two maps out of `I ⊗ F` have the same kernel, so
the descents of each along the other's image factorisation are mutually inverse.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdealSmulMul_mono [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj
      X.ringCatSheaf.property L)
    (hs : IsRegularMeromorphicSection X.sheaf L s)
    [F.IsCoherent] (hF : AlgebraicGeometry.HasNoEmbeddedAssociatedPoints F)
    (hSupp : SheafOfModules.supp F = Set.univ) :
    Mono (denominatorIdealSmulMul X L F s hL hs hF hSupp).val

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealSmulMul_cokernel_support
declarations.doc:
The cokernel of the second canonical map is supported on the exceptional subset.

Off the support of `L / s(I)` the stalk map of multiplication by `s` on the ideal is surjective;
tensoring with `F` and composing with the symmetry keeps it so, and multiplication by `s` on
`I ⊗ F` factors through `I · F`, so the stalk map of the second canonical map is surjective
there as well.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdealSmulMul_cokernel_support [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj
      X.ringCatSheaf.property L)
    (hs : IsRegularMeromorphicSection X.sheaf L s)
    [F.IsCoherent] (hF : AlgebraicGeometry.HasNoEmbeddedAssociatedPoints F)
    (hSupp : SheafOfModules.supp F = Set.univ) :
    SheafOfModules.supp (cokernel (denominatorIdealSmulMul X L F s hL hs hF hSupp).val) ⊆
      denominatorIdealBadLocus X L s

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealTimesModule
declarations.doc: The product `I F`, as a subobject of `F`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def denominatorIdealTimesModule
    (L F : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf)
    (s : MeromorphicSection X.sheaf L) :
    SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf
declarations.comment: the product of the denominator ideal and the module

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealTimesModuleι

noncomputable def denominatorIdealTimesModuleι

    (s : MeromorphicSection X.sheaf L) :
    denominatorIdealTimesModule X L F s ⟶ F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorBadLocus_isClosed
declarations.doc:
If `L` is invertible and `s` is a regular meromorphic section of `L` on a locally Noetherian

declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorBadLocus_isClosed

    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj X.ringCatSheaf.property L) :

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorBadLocus_isNowhereDense
declarations.doc:
If `L` is invertible and `s` is a regular meromorphic section of `L` on a locally Noetherian
scheme, then `denominatorBadLocus X L s` is nowhere dense.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorBadLocus_isNowhereDense

    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj X.ringCatSheaf.property L)

declarations.comment: the exceptional subset is nowhere dense

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealTimesModuleMul
declarations.doc: The canonical section action, specified by its value on local products.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def denominatorIdealTimesModuleMul
    (L F : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf)
    (s : MeromorphicSection X.sheaf L)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj X.ringCatSheaf.property L)

      ⟨X.toRingedSpace.presheaf, X.toRingedSpace.IsSheaf⟩).obj F).obj L) //
        Abelian.factorThruImage (denominatorIdealAction X L F s) ≫ f =
          denominatorIdealSectionTensor X L F s }

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealTimesModuleι_mono

declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdealTimesModuleMul_mono

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.denominatorIdealTimesModuleι_cokernel_support

declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdealTimesModuleι_cokernel_support

declarations.doc:
Under the hypotheses of `denominatorIdealTimesModuleMul`, the cokernel of the second
canonical map `I F ⟶ F ⊗ L` is supported on `denominatorBadLocus X L s`.
declarations.statement:
theorem denominatorIdealTimesModuleMul_cokernel_supp
    (L F : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf)
    (s : MeromorphicSection X.sheaf L)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.IsAdmissibleSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02P6.** A finite sequence in a module over a local ring is
admissible if the maximal ideal times each entry is contained in the span of the preceding
entries.
declarations.statement:
public def IsAdmissibleSequence {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {n : ℕ} (e : Fin n → M) : Prop

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.AdmissibleSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02P6.** The symbols used to generate the determinant: admissible
sequences whose length is the length of the module.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev AdmissibleSequence (R : Type u) (M : Type v) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.DeterminantRelation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02P6.** The three families of admissible relations: a dependent
entry gives zero, replacing an entry up to a unit and earlier entries scales by the residue
of that unit, and two adjacent entries may be exchanged with a sign when the later entry
satisfies the stronger admissibility condition.
declarations.statement:
public inductive DeterminantRelation {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R]
    [IsLocalRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] : DeterminantFree R M → Prop

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.determinant
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02P6.** The determinant of a finite-length module over a local
ring, as a vector space over the residue field.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev determinant (R : Type u) (M : Type v) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.span_symbol_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tags 02P7 and 02P9.** The symbol of every admissible sequence that
spans a finite-length module generates its determinant over the residue field.

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.finrank_determinant_le_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02P7.** The determinant of a finite-length module over a local
ring has dimension at most one over the residue field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finrank_determinant_le_one
    (R : Type u) (M : Type v) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (determinant R M) ≤ 1

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.exists_span_eq_top_and_span_symbol_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02P7.** A finite-length module over a local ring has an
admissible sequence that spans it, and the symbol of that sequence generates the
determinant over the residue field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_span_eq_top_and_span_symbol_eq_top
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    ∃ e : AdmissibleSequence R M, Submodule.span R (Set.range e.1) = ⊤ ∧
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) ∙ symbol e = ⊤

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.rank_determinant_le_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02P7.** The determinant of a finite-length module over a local
ring has dimension at most one over the residue field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem rank_determinant_le_one
    (R : Type u) (M : Type v) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    Module.rank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (determinant R M) ≤ 1

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.determinantExteriorPowerComparison
declarations.doc:
For a finite-dimensional module over the residue field of a local ring, the determinant
defined from admissible symbols is isomorphic to its top exterior power. Under this
isomorphism a symbol is sent to the exterior product of its entries.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def determinantExteriorPowerComparison
    (R : Type u) (M : Type v) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) M]
    [IsScalarTower R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) M]
    [Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) M] :
    DeterminantExteriorPowerComparison R M

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.finrank_determinant_eq_one
declarations.doc:
The determinant of a finite-length module over a local ring has dimension one over the
residue field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finrank_determinant_eq_one {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R]
    [IsLocalRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (determinant R M) = 1

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.span_symbol_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tags 02P7 and 02P9.** The symbol of every admissible sequence that
spans a finite-length module generates its determinant over the residue field.

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.determinantExactSequenceMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PA (determinant exact-sequence map).** The canonical linear map
from the tensor product of the determinants of the outer terms of a short exact sequence to
the determinant of its middle term.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def determinantExactSequenceMap
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {K : Type v} {L : Type w} {M : Type x}
    [AddCommGroup K] [Module R K] [AddCommGroup L] [Module R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (i : K →ₗ[R] L) (p : L →ₗ[R] M)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hp : Function.Surjective p) (hip : Function.Exact i p)
    (hK : IsFiniteLength R K) (hL : IsFiniteLength R L) (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    determinant R K ⊗[IsLocalRing.ResidueField R] determinant R M →ₗ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField R]
      determinant R L

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.determinantExactSequenceMap_bijective
declarations.doc:
**The determinant map of a short exact sequence is an isomorphism.** For a short exact
sequence `0 → K → L → M → 0` of finite-length modules over a local ring, the determinant map
`det(K) ⊗ det(M) → det(L)` is bijective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem determinantExactSequenceMap_bijective
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {K : Type v} {L : Type w} {M : Type x}
    [AddCommGroup K] [Module R K] [AddCommGroup L] [Module R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (i : K →ₗ[R] L) (p : L →ₗ[R] M)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hp : Function.Surjective p) (hip : Function.Exact i p)
    (hK : IsFiniteLength R K) (hL : IsFiniteLength R L) (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    Function.Bijective (determinantExactSequenceMap i p hi hp hip hK hL hM)

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.determinantExactSequenceMap_natural
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PA (`gamma_natural`).** The determinant map of a short
exact sequence is natural under an isomorphism of short exact sequences.
declarations.statement:
public theorem determinantExactSequenceMap_natural
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {K L M K' L' M' : FiniteLengthModuleIso.{u, v} R}
    (i : K.of.obj →ₗ[R] L.of.obj) (p : L.of.obj →ₗ[R] M.of.obj)
    (i' : K'.of.obj →ₗ[R] L'.of.obj) (p' : L'.of.obj →ₗ[R] M'.of.obj)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hp : Function.Surjective p)
    (hip : Function.Exact i p)
    (hi' : Function.Injective i') (hp' : Function.Surjective p')
    (hip' : Function.Exact i' p')
    (u : K ⟶ K') (v : L ⟶ L') (w : M ⟶ M')
    (hu : i'.comp u.iso.hom.hom.hom = v.iso.hom.hom.hom.comp i)
    (hw : p'.comp v.iso.hom.hom.hom = w.iso.hom.hom.hom.comp p) :
    (determinantExactSequenceMap i' p' hi' hp' hip'
      K'.of.property L'.of.property M'.of.property).comp
        (TensorProduct.map
          ((determinantFunctor R).mapLinearEquiv u).toLinearMap
          ((determinantFunctor R).mapLinearEquiv w).toLinearMap) =
      ((determinantFunctor R).mapLinearEquiv v).toLinearMap.comp
        (determinantExactSequenceMap i p hi hp hip
          K.of.property L.of.property M.of.property)

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.determinantExactSequenceMap_three_by_three
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PA (`gamma_three_by_three`).** In a commutative
three-by-three diagram with exact rows and columns, the two composites of determinant maps
coincide after the middle determinant factors are interchanged with the Koszul sign.
declarations.statement:
public theorem determinantExactSequenceMap_three_by_three
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {A : Type vA} {B : Type vB} {C : Type vC}
    {D : Type vD} {E : Type vE} {F : Type vF}
    {G : Type vG} {H : Type vH} {I : Type vI}
    [AddCommGroup A] [Module R A] [AddCommGroup B] [Module R B]
    [AddCommGroup C] [Module R C] [AddCommGroup D] [Module R D]
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module R E] [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F]
    [AddCommGroup G] [Module R G] [AddCommGroup H] [Module R H]
    [AddCommGroup I] [Module R I]
    (iAB : A →ₗ[R] B) (pBC : B →ₗ[R] C)
    (iDE : D →ₗ[R] E) (pEF : E →ₗ[R] F)
    (iGH : G →ₗ[R] H) (pHI : H →ₗ[R] I)
    (iAD : A →ₗ[R] D) (iBE : B →ₗ[R] E) (iCF : C →ₗ[R] F)
    (pDG : D →ₗ[R] G) (pEH : E →ₗ[R] H) (pFI : F →ₗ[R] I)
    (hAB : Function.Injective iAB) (hBC : Function.Surjective pBC)
    (hexABC : Function.Exact iAB pBC)
    (hDE : Function.Injective iDE) (hEF : Function.Surjective pEF)
    (hexDEF : Function.Exact iDE pEF)
    (hGH : Function.Injective iGH) (hHI : Function.Surjective pHI)
    (hexGHI : Function.Exact iGH pHI)
    (hAD : Function.Injective iAD) (hDG : Function.Surjective pDG)
    (hexADG : Function.Exact iAD pDG)
    (hBE : Function.Injective iBE) (hEH : Function.Surjective pEH)
    (hexBEH : Function.Exact iBE pEH)
    (hCF : Function.Injective iCF) (hFI : Function.Surjective pFI)
    (hexCFI : Function.Exact iCF pFI)
    (commADEB : iDE.comp iAD = iBE.comp iAB)
    (commBEFC : pEF.comp iBE = iCF.comp pBC)
    (commDGEH : iGH.comp pDG = pEH.comp iDE)
    (commEHIF : pHI.comp pEH = pFI.comp pEF)
    (hA : IsFiniteLength R A) (hB : IsFiniteLength R B) (hC : IsFiniteLength R C)
    (hD : IsFiniteLength R D) (hE : IsFiniteLength R E) (hF : IsFiniteLength R F)
    (hG : IsFiniteLength R G) (hH : IsFiniteLength R H) (hI : IsFiniteLength R I) :
    (determinantExactSequenceMap iBE pEH hBE hEH hexBEH hB hE hH).comp
        (TensorProduct.map
          (determinantExactSequenceMap iAB pBC hAB hBC hexABC hA hB hC)
          (determinantExactSequenceMap iGH pHI hGH hHI hexGHI hG hH hI)) =
      (determinantExactSequenceMap iDE pEF hDE hEF hexDEF hD hE hF).comp
        ((TensorProduct.map
          (determinantExactSequenceMap iAD pDG hAD hDG hexADG hA hD hG)
          (determinantExactSequenceMap iCF pFI hCF hFI hexCFI hC hF hI)).comp
            (signedTensorInterchange (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
              (determinant R A) (determinant R C) (determinant R G) (determinant R I)
              (moduleLength R C) (moduleLength R G)))

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.determinantExactSequenceMap_comparison_apply
declarations.doc:
For a short exact sequence of finite-dimensional vector spaces over the residue field of a
local ring, under the canonical comparison of the determinant with the top exterior power, the
determinant map sends the exterior products of two lists of vectors to the exterior product of
the first list's image followed by arbitrary lifts of the second list.
declarations.statement:
public theorem determinantExactSequenceMap_comparison_apply
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {K : Type v} {L : Type w} {M : Type x}
    [AddCommGroup K] [Module R K] [Module (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K]
    [IsScalarTower R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K]
    [AddCommGroup L] [Module R L] [Module (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) L]
    [IsScalarTower R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) M]
    [IsScalarTower R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) M]
    [Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K]
    [Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) L]
    [Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) M]
    (i : K →ₗ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField R] L)
    (p : L →ₗ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField R] M)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hp : Function.Surjective p) (hip : Function.Exact i p)
    (hK : IsFiniteLength R K) (hL : IsFiniteLength R L) (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    ∃ hdim : Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) L =
        Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K +
          Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) M,
      ∀ (e : Fin (Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K) → K)
        (fbar : Fin (Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) M) → M)
        (f : Fin (Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) M) → L),
        (∀ a, p (f a) = fbar a) →
          (determinantExteriorPowerComparison R L).equiv
              (determinantExactSequenceMap (i.restrictScalars R) (p.restrictScalars R)
                hi hp hip hK hL hM
                ((determinantExteriorPowerComparison R K).equiv.symm
                    (exteriorPower.ιMulti (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
                      (Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K) e) ⊗ₜ
                  (determinantExteriorPowerComparison R M).equiv.symm
                    (exteriorPower.ιMulti (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
                      (Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) M) fbar))) =
            exteriorPower.ιMulti (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
              (Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) L)
              (fun a ↦ Fin.append (fun b ↦ i (e b)) f (Fin.cast hdim a))

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.DeterminantTheory.existsUnique_comparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PB.** The determinant functor of finite-length modules over a
local ring, endowed with the maps `γ_{K → L → M}`, is characterized by its properties: every
determinant theory, that is, every functor with maps `γ` whose restriction to modules
annihilated by the maximal ideal is isomorphic to the usual determinant functor and which has
properties (1), (2) and (3) of Tag 02PA, is isomorphic to the canonical one by a unique
isomorphism compatible with all of this structure.
declarations.statement:
public theorem DeterminantTheory.existsUnique_comparison {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [IsLocalRing R] (D : DeterminantTheory.{u, v, w} R) :
    ∃! η : ∀ M : FiniteLengthModuleIso.{u, v} R,
      (D.toFunctor.obj M).of.obj ≃ₗ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField R]
        ((DeterminantTheory.canonical R).toFunctor.obj M).of.obj,
      D.IsComparison (DeterminantTheory.canonical R) η

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.isFiniteLength_restrictScalars
declarations.doc: A module of finite length over `R` has finite length over `R₀`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFiniteLength_restrictScalars
    {R₀ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommRing R₀] [IsLocalRing R₀]
    [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [Algebra R₀ R]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R₀ R)]
    (hκ : Function.Bijective (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R₀ R)))
    {M : Type w} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R₀ M] [Module R M]
    [IsScalarTower R₀ R M] (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    IsFiniteLength R₀ M

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.moduleLength_restrictScalars
declarations.doc:
The length is unchanged by restriction along a local homomorphism inducing an
isomorphism of residue fields.
declarations.statement:
public theorem moduleLength_restrictScalars
    {R₀ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommRing R₀] [IsLocalRing R₀]
    [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [Algebra R₀ R]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R₀ R)]
    (hκ : Function.Bijective (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R₀ R)))
    {M : Type w} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R₀ M] [Module R M]
    [IsScalarTower R₀ R M] (_hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    moduleLength R M = moduleLength R₀ M

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.determinantRestrictScalarsEquiv
declarations.doc:
The canonical comparison of determinant spaces for a local ring map with unchanged
residue field.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def determinantRestrictScalarsEquiv
    {R₀ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommRing R₀] [IsLocalRing R₀]
    [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [Algebra R₀ R]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R₀ R)]
    (hκ : Function.Bijective (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R₀ R)))
    {M : Type w} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R₀ M] [Module R M]
    [IsScalarTower R₀ R M] (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    determinant R M ≃ₛₗ[RingHomClass.toRingHom (RingEquiv.ofBijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R₀ R)) hκ).symm]
      determinant R₀ M

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.determinantRestrictScalarsEquiv_symbol
declarations.doc:
The canonical comparison takes a determinant symbol to the symbol of the same
sequence over the smaller local ring.
declarations.statement:
public theorem determinantRestrictScalarsEquiv_symbol
    {R₀ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommRing R₀] [IsLocalRing R₀]
    [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [Algebra R₀ R]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R₀ R)]
    (hκ : Function.Bijective (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R₀ R)))
    {M : Type w} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R₀ M] [Module R M]
    [IsScalarTower R₀ R M] (hM : IsFiniteLength R M)
    (e : AdmissibleSequence R M) :
    determinantRestrictScalarsEquiv hκ hM (symbol e) =
    symbol ⟨fun i : Fin (moduleLength R₀ M) ↦
      e.1 (Fin.cast (moduleLength_restrictScalars hκ hM).symm i),
      admissibleSequence_restrictScalars hκ hM e⟩

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.determinantRestrictScalarsEquiv_natural
declarations.doc:
The canonical comparison commutes with symbol-preserving determinant maps induced
by an isomorphism of modules.
declarations.statement:
public theorem determinantRestrictScalarsEquiv_natural
    {R₀ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommRing R₀] [IsLocalRing R₀]
    [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [Algebra R₀ R]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R₀ R)]
    (hκ : Function.Bijective (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R₀ R)))
    {M : Type w} {N : Type x}
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R₀ M] [Module R M] [IsScalarTower R₀ R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R₀ N] [Module R N] [IsScalarTower R₀ R N]
    (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) (hN : IsFiniteLength R N)
    (g : M ≃ₗ[R] N)
    (gR : determinant R M ≃ₗ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField R] determinant R N)
    (gR₀ : determinant R₀ M ≃ₗ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField R₀] determinant R₀ N)
    (hgR : ∀ e : AdmissibleSequence R M, ∃ e' : AdmissibleSequence R N,
      (∃ h : moduleLength R M = moduleLength R N,
        ∀ i, e'.1 (Fin.cast h i) = g (e.1 i)) ∧
      gR (symbol e) = symbol e')
    (hgR₀ : ∀ e : AdmissibleSequence R₀ M, ∃ e' : AdmissibleSequence R₀ N,
      (∃ h : moduleLength R₀ M = moduleLength R₀ N,
        ∀ i, e'.1 (Fin.cast h i) = g (e.1 i)) ∧
      gR₀ (symbol e) = symbol e')
    (z : determinant R M) :
    determinantRestrictScalarsEquiv hκ hN (gR z) =
      gR₀ (determinantRestrictScalarsEquiv hκ hM z)

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.determinantRestrictScalarsEquiv_exact
declarations.doc:
The determinant comparison respects the canonical determinant isomorphism of a
short exact sequence.
declarations.statement:
public theorem determinantRestrictScalarsEquiv_exact
    {R₀ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommRing R₀] [IsLocalRing R₀]
    [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [Algebra R₀ R]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R₀ R)]
    (hκ : Function.Bijective (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R₀ R)))
    {K : Type w} {L : Type x} {M : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup K] [Module R₀ K] [Module R K] [IsScalarTower R₀ R K]
    [AddCommGroup L] [Module R₀ L] [Module R L] [IsScalarTower R₀ R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R₀ M] [Module R M] [IsScalarTower R₀ R M]
    (i : K →ₗ[R] L) (p : L →ₗ[R] M)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hp : Function.Surjective p) (hip : Function.Exact i p)
    (hK : IsFiniteLength R K) (hL : IsFiniteLength R L) (hM : IsFiniteLength R M)
    (a : determinant R K) (b : determinant R M) :
    determinantRestrictScalarsEquiv hκ hL
        (determinantExactSequenceMap i p hi hp hip hK hL hM (a ⊗ₜ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField R] b)) =
      determinantExactSequenceMap (i.restrictScalars R₀) (p.restrictScalars R₀)
        hi hp hip (isFiniteLength_restrictScalars hκ hK)
        (isFiniteLength_restrictScalars hκ hL)
        (isFiniteLength_restrictScalars hκ hM)
        ((determinantRestrictScalarsEquiv hκ hK a) ⊗ₜ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField R₀]
          (determinantRestrictScalarsEquiv hκ hM b))

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.determinantFunctor_map_unit_smul
declarations.doc:
Multiplication by a unit on a finite-length module acts on its determinant
by the corresponding power of the residue of that unit.
declarations.statement:
public theorem determinantFunctor_map_unit_smul
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (X : FiniteLengthModuleIso.{u, v} R) (a : Rˣ) (f : X ⟶ X)
    (hf : ∀ m : X.of.obj, f.iso.hom.hom.hom m = (a : R) • m)
    (x : determinant R X.of.obj) :
    (determinantFunctor R).mapLinearEquiv f x =
      (IsLocalRing.residue R a ^ moduleLength R X.of.obj) • x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.periodicLength
declarations.doc:
The multiplicity (or periodic length) of a two-periodic complex of modules. For a complex
whose two objects agree, this is also known as its additive Herbrand quotient.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable abbrev periodicLength {R : Type u} [Ring R]
    (C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ZMod 2)) : ℤ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.periodicDeterminant
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PJ.** The determinant of an exact two-periodic complex on a
finite-length module over a local ring.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def periodicDeterminant
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (φ ψ : M →ₗ[R] M) (hφψ : Function.Exact φ ψ)
    (hψφ : Function.Exact ψ φ) (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)ˣ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.periodicDeterminant_symbol_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PK.** For an exact two-periodic complex, the determinant symbol
formed from an admissible sequence in the image of the first differential and lifts from the
second image differs from the opposite symbol by the signed periodic determinant.
declarations.statement:
theorem periodicDeterminant_symbol_eq
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (φ ψ : M →ₗ[R] M)
    (hφψ : Function.Exact φ ψ) (hψφ : Function.Exact ψ φ)
    (hM : IsFiniteLength R M)
    (x : AdmissibleSequence R (LinearMap.range φ))
    (y : AdmissibleSequence R (LinearMap.range ψ))
    (hx : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) ∙ symbol x = ⊤)
    (hy : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) ∙ symbol y = ⊤)
    (xLift : Fin (moduleLength R (LinearMap.range φ)) → M)
    (yLift : Fin (moduleLength R (LinearMap.range ψ)) → M)
    (hxLift : ∀ i, φ (xLift i) = (x.1 i : M))
    (hyLift : ∀ j, ψ (yLift j) = (y.1 j : M)) :
    ∃ hleftLength : moduleLength R M =
        moduleLength R (LinearMap.range φ) + moduleLength R (LinearMap.range ψ),
      ∃ hrightLength : moduleLength R M =
          moduleLength R (LinearMap.range ψ) + moduleLength R (LinearMap.range φ),
        ∃ hleft : IsAdmissibleSequence (R := R)
            (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ (x.1 j : M)) yLift (Fin.cast hleftLength i)),
          ∃ hright : IsAdmissibleSequence (R := R)
              (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ (y.1 j : M)) xLift
                (Fin.cast hrightLength i)),
            symbol ⟨fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ (x.1 j : M)) yLift
                (Fin.cast hleftLength i), hleft⟩ =
              (((-1 : IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) ^
                (moduleLength R (LinearMap.range φ) *
                  moduleLength R (LinearMap.range ψ))) *
                (periodicDeterminant φ ψ hφψ hψφ hM : IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) •
                symbol ⟨fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ (y.1 j : M)) xLift
                (Fin.cast hrightLength i), hright⟩

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.eq_periodicDeterminant_of_symbol_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PK.** The signed comparison of symbols of generating admissible
sequences uniquely determines the determinant of an exact two-periodic complex.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_periodicDeterminant_of_symbol_eq
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (φ ψ : M →ₗ[R] M)
    (hφψ : Function.Exact φ ψ) (hψφ : Function.Exact ψ φ)
    (hM : IsFiniteLength R M)
    (x : AdmissibleSequence R (LinearMap.range φ))
    (y : AdmissibleSequence R (LinearMap.range ψ))
    (hx : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) ∙ symbol x = ⊤)
    (hy : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) ∙ symbol y = ⊤)
    (xLift : Fin (moduleLength R (LinearMap.range φ)) → M)
    (yLift : Fin (moduleLength R (LinearMap.range ψ)) → M)
    (hxLift : ∀ i, φ (xLift i) = (x.1 i : M))
    (hyLift : ∀ j, ψ (yLift j) = (y.1 j : M))
    (hleftLength : moduleLength R M =
      moduleLength R (LinearMap.range φ) + moduleLength R (LinearMap.range ψ))
    (hrightLength : moduleLength R M =
      moduleLength R (LinearMap.range ψ) + moduleLength R (LinearMap.range φ))
    (hleft : IsAdmissibleSequence (R := R)
      (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ (x.1 j : M)) yLift (Fin.cast hleftLength i)))
    (hright : IsAdmissibleSequence (R := R)
      (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ (y.1 j : M)) xLift (Fin.cast hrightLength i)))
    (d : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)ˣ)
    (hd : symbol ⟨fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ (x.1 j : M)) yLift
        (Fin.cast hleftLength i), hleft⟩ =
      (((-1 : IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) ^
        (moduleLength R (LinearMap.range φ) *
          moduleLength R (LinearMap.range ψ))) *
        (d : IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) •
        symbol ⟨fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ (y.1 j : M)) xLift
          (Fin.cast hrightLength i), hright⟩) :
    d = periodicDeterminant φ ψ hφψ hψφ hM

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.periodicDeterminant_mul_swap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PL.** Interchanging the two maps of an exact two-periodic complex
inverts its periodic determinant.
declarations.statement:
theorem periodicDeterminant_mul_swap
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (φ ψ : M →ₗ[R] M) (hφψ : Function.Exact φ ψ)
    (hψφ : Function.Exact ψ φ) (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    periodicDeterminant φ ψ hφψ hψφ hM *
        periodicDeterminant ψ φ hψφ hφψ hM = 1

declarations.name: Module.length_eq_twice_image_length
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PM.** The length of an exact one-differential periodic complex is
twice the length of the image of its differential.
declarations.statement:
lemma length_eq_twice_image_length (φ : M →ₗ[R] M) (hφ : Function.Exact φ φ) :
    Module.length R M = 2 * Module.length R (LinearMap.range φ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.periodicDeterminant_self_eq_negOne_pow_range_length
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PM.** The determinant of an exact one-differential periodic
complex is the sign of the length of the image of its differential.
declarations.statement:
theorem periodicDeterminant_self_eq_negOne_pow_range_length
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] M) (hφ : Function.Exact φ φ) (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    periodicDeterminant φ φ hφ hφ hM =
      (-1 : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)ˣ) ^ moduleLength R (LinearMap.range φ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.periodicDeterminant_self_eq_negOne_pow_half_length
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PM.** The same determinant is the sign of half the length of the
underlying module.
declarations.statement:
theorem periodicDeterminant_self_eq_negOne_pow_half_length
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] M) (hφ : Function.Exact φ φ) (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    periodicDeterminant φ φ hφ hφ hM =
      (-1 : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)ˣ) ^ (moduleLength R M / 2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.periodicDeterminant_equiv_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PN, part (1).** The periodic determinant of an automorphism and
zero is the determinant of the automorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem periodicDeterminant_equiv_zero
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (e : M ≃ₗ[R] M)
    (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    periodicDeterminant (e : M →ₗ[R] M) 0
      (by rw [LinearMap.exact_iff]; simp [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr e.surjective])
      (by rw [LinearMap.exact_iff]; simp [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr e.injective])
      hM = determinantAutomorphism e hM

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.periodicDeterminant_zero_equiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PN, part (2).** The periodic determinant of zero and an
automorphism is the inverse of its determinant.
declarations.statement:
theorem periodicDeterminant_zero_equiv
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (e : M ≃ₗ[R] M)
    (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    periodicDeterminant 0 (e : M →ₗ[R] M)
      (by rw [LinearMap.exact_iff]; simp [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr e.injective])
      (by rw [LinearMap.exact_iff]; simp [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr e.surjective])
      hM = (determinantAutomorphism e hM)⁻¹

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.periodicDeterminant_short_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PO.** The periodic determinant is multiplicative in a short exact
sequence of exact two-periodic complexes of finite-length modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem periodicDeterminant_short_exact
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {M₁ : Type v₁} {M₂ : Type v₂} {M₃ : Type v₃}
    [AddCommGroup M₁] [Module R M₁]
    [AddCommGroup M₂] [Module R M₂]
    [AddCommGroup M₃] [Module R M₃]
    (φ₁ ψ₁ : M₁ →ₗ[R] M₁) (φ₂ ψ₂ : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₂)
    (φ₃ ψ₃ : M₃ →ₗ[R] M₃)
    (i : M₁ →ₗ[R] M₂) (p : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hp : Function.Surjective p)
    (hip : Function.Exact i p)
    (hφi : φ₂.comp i = i.comp φ₁)
    (hψi : ψ₂.comp i = i.comp ψ₁)
    (hφp : φ₃.comp p = p.comp φ₂)
    (hψp : ψ₃.comp p = p.comp ψ₂)
    (hφψ₁ : Function.Exact φ₁ ψ₁) (hψφ₁ : Function.Exact ψ₁ φ₁)
    (hφψ₂ : Function.Exact φ₂ ψ₂) (hψφ₂ : Function.Exact ψ₂ φ₂)
    (hφψ₃ : Function.Exact φ₃ ψ₃) (hψφ₃ : Function.Exact ψ₃ φ₃)
    (hM₁ : IsFiniteLength R M₁) (hM₂ : IsFiniteLength R M₂)
    (hM₃ : IsFiniteLength R M₃) :
    periodicDeterminant φ₂ ψ₂ hφψ₂ hψφ₂ hM₂ =
      periodicDeterminant φ₁ ψ₁ hφψ₁ hψφ₁ hM₁ *
        periodicDeterminant φ₃ ψ₃ hφψ₃ hψφ₃ hM₃

declarations.name: DualNumber.span_symbol_dualNumberSequence_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PP.** The symbol `[ε, 1]` of the admissible sequence `(ε, 1)` of the
dual numbers over themselves generates their determinant over the residue field.
declarations.statement:
theorem span_symbol_dualNumberSequence_eq_top (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (DualNumber k)) ∙ symbol (dualNumberSequence k) = ⊤

declarations.name: DualNumber.periodicGamma_unitMulT_dualRangeSequence_first
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PP.** For the short exact sequence of the dual numbers given by the
image of multiplication by `v ε` and multiplication by `u ε`, the determinant map sends the tensor
of the two classes of `ε` to `u⁻¹ [ε, 1]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem periodicGamma_unitMulT_dualRangeSequence_first (k : Type u) [Field k] (u v : kˣ)
    (hvu : Function.Exact (unitMulT k v) (unitMulT k u))
    (hM : IsFiniteLength (DualNumber k) (DualNumber k)) :
    periodicGamma (unitMulT k u) (unitMulT k v) hvu hM
      (symbol (dualRangeSequence k v) ⊗ₜ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField (DualNumber k)]
        symbol (dualRangeSequence k u)) =
      algebraMap k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (DualNumber k)) ((u⁻¹ : kˣ) : k) •
        symbol (dualNumberSequence k)

declarations.name: DualNumber.periodicGamma_unitMulT_dualRangeSequence_second
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PP.** For the short exact sequence of the dual numbers given by the
image of multiplication by `u ε` and multiplication by `v ε`, the determinant map sends the tensor
of the two classes of `ε` to `v⁻¹ [ε, 1]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem periodicGamma_unitMulT_dualRangeSequence_second (k : Type u) [Field k] (u v : kˣ)
    (huv : Function.Exact (unitMulT k u) (unitMulT k v))
    (hM : IsFiniteLength (DualNumber k) (DualNumber k)) :
    periodicGamma (unitMulT k v) (unitMulT k u) huv hM
      (symbol (dualRangeSequence k u) ⊗ₜ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField (DualNumber k)]
        symbol (dualRangeSequence k v)) =
      algebraMap k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (DualNumber k)) ((v⁻¹ : kˣ) : k) •
        symbol (dualNumberSequence k)

declarations.name: DualNumber.periodicDeterminant_unitMulT
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PP.** The periodic determinant of multiplication by `u ε` and
`v ε` on the dual numbers is `-u / v`.
declarations.statement:
theorem periodicDeterminant_unitMulT (k : Type u) [Field k] (u v : kˣ) :
    ∃ (hφψ : Function.Exact (unitMulT k u) (unitMulT k v))
      (hψφ : Function.Exact (unitMulT k v) (unitMulT k u))
      (hM : IsFiniteLength (DualNumber k) (DualNumber k)),
      periodicDeterminant (unitMulT k u) (unitMulT k v) hφψ hψφ hM =
        Units.map (algebraMap k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (DualNumber k))) (-u / v)

declarations.name: DualNumber.range_unitMulT
declarations.doc: The image of multiplication by a unit multiple of `ε` is the ideal generated by `ε`.
declarations.statement:
theorem range_unitMulT (k : Type u) [Field k] (u : kˣ) :
    LinearMap.range (unitMulT k u) = Ideal.span {DualNumber.eps}

declarations.name: DualNumber.ker_unitMulT
declarations.doc: The kernel of multiplication by a unit multiple of `ε` is the ideal generated by `ε`.
declarations.statement:
theorem ker_unitMulT (k : Type u) [Field k] (u : kˣ) :
    LinearMap.ker (unitMulT k u) = Ideal.span {DualNumber.eps}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.periodicDeterminant_padicInt_quotient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PQ.** Let `p` be a prime, let `a + b = l`, and let `u` and `v` be
units of `ℤ_[p]`. Multiplication by `p ^ b * u` and by `p ^ a * v` on `ℤ_[p] / (p ^ l)` is an
exact two-periodic complex of finite length, and its periodic determinant is
`(-1) ^ (a * b) * u ^ a / v ^ b` in the residue field of `ℤ_[p]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem periodicDeterminant_padicInt_quotient (a b l : ℕ) (hl : a + b = l) (u v : ℤ_[p]ˣ) :
    ∃ (hφψ : Function.Exact
        (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ_[p] (ℤ_[p] ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ l})
          ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ b * (u : ℤ_[p])))
        (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ_[p] (ℤ_[p] ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ l})
          ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ a * (v : ℤ_[p]))))
      (hψφ : Function.Exact
        (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ_[p] (ℤ_[p] ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ l})
          ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ a * (v : ℤ_[p])))
        (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ_[p] (ℤ_[p] ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ l})
          ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ b * (u : ℤ_[p]))))
      (hM : IsFiniteLength ℤ_[p] (ℤ_[p] ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ l})),
      periodicDeterminant
          (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ_[p] (ℤ_[p] ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ l})
            ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ b * (u : ℤ_[p])))
          (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ_[p] (ℤ_[p] ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ l})
            ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ a * (v : ℤ_[p]))) hφψ hψφ hM =
        (-1) ^ (a * b) *
          Units.map (IsLocalRing.residue ℤ_[p]).toMonoidHom (u ^ a / v ^ b)
declarations.comment: the determinant of the p-adic periodic complex

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.periodicDeterminant_padicInt_quotient_toZMod
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PQ.** The same determinant read in `𝔽_p = ZMod p` and written with
the orders of vanishing of the two differentials `α = p ^ b * u` and `β = p ^ a * v`: it is
`(-1) ^ (ord α * ord β)` times the reduction mod `p` of the unit `α ^ (ord β) / β ^ (ord α)`,
which is exhibited together with its defining identity in `ℚ_[p]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem periodicDeterminant_padicInt_quotient_toZMod (a b l : ℕ) (hl : a + b = l)
    (u v : ℤ_[p]ˣ) :
    ∃ (hφψ : Function.Exact
        (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ_[p] (ℤ_[p] ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ l})
          ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ b * (u : ℤ_[p])))
        (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ_[p] (ℤ_[p] ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ l})
          ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ a * (v : ℤ_[p]))))
      (hψφ : Function.Exact
        (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ_[p] (ℤ_[p] ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ l})
          ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ a * (v : ℤ_[p])))
        (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ_[p] (ℤ_[p] ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ l})
          ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ b * (u : ℤ_[p]))))
      (hM : IsFiniteLength ℤ_[p] (ℤ_[p] ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ l})) (w : ℤ_[p]ˣ),
      algebraMap ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] (w : ℤ_[p]) =
          algebraMap ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ b * (u : ℤ_[p])) ^
              ordInt ℤ_[p] (algebraMap ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ a * (v : ℤ_[p])))
                (padicInt_algebraMap_pow_mul_unit_ne_zero p a v) /
            algebraMap ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ a * (v : ℤ_[p])) ^
              ordInt ℤ_[p] (algebraMap ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ b * (u : ℤ_[p])))
                (padicInt_algebraMap_pow_mul_unit_ne_zero p b u) ∧
        PadicInt.residueField
            ((periodicDeterminant
              (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ_[p] (ℤ_[p] ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ l})
                ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ b * (u : ℤ_[p])))
              (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ_[p] (ℤ_[p] ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ l})
                ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ a * (v : ℤ_[p]))) hφψ hψφ hM :
                IsLocalRing.ResidueField ℤ_[p])) =
          (-1) ^ (ordInt ℤ_[p] (algebraMap ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ b * (u : ℤ_[p])))
                (padicInt_algebraMap_pow_mul_unit_ne_zero p b u) *
              ordInt ℤ_[p] (algebraMap ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ a * (v : ℤ_[p])))
                (padicInt_algebraMap_pow_mul_unit_ne_zero p a v)) *
            PadicInt.toZMod (w : ℤ_[p])
declarations.comment: the determinant mod p in order-of-vanishing form

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.periodicDeterminant_upperBlockEndomorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PS.** The periodic determinant of two invertible upper-right
blocks is the signed ratio of their ordinary matrix determinants.
declarations.statement:
theorem periodicDeterminant_upperBlockEndomorphism
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (a : ℕ)
    (U V : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin a) k) (hU : IsUnit U) (hV : IsUnit V) :
    ∃ (hUV : Function.Exact (upperBlockEndomorphism U) (upperBlockEndomorphism V))
      (hVU : Function.Exact (upperBlockEndomorphism V) (upperBlockEndomorphism U))
      (hM : IsFiniteLength k ((Fin a → k) × (Fin a → k))),
      (periodicDeterminant (upperBlockEndomorphism U) (upperBlockEndomorphism V)
        hUV hVU hM : IsLocalRing.ResidueField k) =
        (-1 : IsLocalRing.ResidueField k) ^ a *
          IsLocalRing.residue k U.det / IsLocalRing.residue k V.det

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.periodicDeterminant_crossPair
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PT.** For nonzero `u₁, u₂, v₁, v₂` in a field `k`, the two
endomorphisms of `k^{⊕ 4}` with single nonzero matrix entries `u₁, u₂` and `v₂, v₁` form an
exact two-periodic complex whose periodic determinant is `-u₁u₂/(v₁v₂)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem periodicDeterminant_crossPair {k : Type u} [Field k] (u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ : kˣ) :
    ∃ (hφψ : Function.Exact (crossPairFirst (u₁ : k) u₂) (crossPairSecond (v₁ : k) v₂))
      (hψφ : Function.Exact (crossPairSecond (v₁ : k) v₂) (crossPairFirst (u₁ : k) u₂))
      (hM : IsFiniteLength k (Fin 4 → k)),
      (periodicDeterminant (crossPairFirst (u₁ : k) u₂) (crossPairSecond (v₁ : k) v₂)
        hφψ hψφ hM : IsLocalRing.ResidueField k) =
        -(IsLocalRing.residue k ((u₁ : k) * u₂) / IsLocalRing.residue k ((v₁ : k) * v₂))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exact_alpha_betaGamma
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PU.** Exactness of `α` followed by `βγ` on the original

declarations.statement:
theorem exact_alpha_betaGamma (α β γ : M →ₗ[R] M)
    (h : ComplementaryImagesKernels α β γ) :

declarations.statement:
theorem exact_betaGamma_alpha (α β γ : M →ₗ[R] M)
    (h : ComplementaryImagesKernels α β γ) :

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exact_alpha_beta_onGammaRange
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 02PU.** Exactness of `α` followed by `β` on the image of `γ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_alpha_beta_onGammaRange (α β γ : M →ₗ[R] M)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exact_beta_alpha_onGammaRange
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 02PU.** Exactness of `β` followed by `α` on the image of `γ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_beta_alpha_onGammaRange (α β γ : M →ₗ[R] M)
    (h : ComplementaryImagesKernels α β γ) :
    Function.Exact (betaOnGammaRange α β γ h) (alphaOnGammaRange α β γ h)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exact_alpha_gamma_onKerBetaQuotient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PU.** Exactness of `α` followed by `γ` on the quotient by the
kernel of `β`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_alpha_gamma_onKerBetaQuotient (α β γ : M →ₗ[R] M)
    (h : ComplementaryImagesKernels α β γ) :
    Function.Exact (alphaOnKerBetaQuotient α β γ h)
      (gammaOnKerBetaQuotient α β γ h)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exact_gamma_alpha_onKerBetaQuotient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PU.** Exactness of `γ` followed by `α` on the quotient by the
kernel of `β`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_gamma_alpha_onKerBetaQuotient (α β γ : M →ₗ[R] M)
    (h : ComplementaryImagesKernels α β γ) :
    Function.Exact (gammaOnKerBetaQuotient α β γ h)
      (alphaOnKerBetaQuotient α β γ h)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.periodicDeterminant_mul
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PU.** The determinant of `(M, α, βγ)` is the product of the
determinants on the image of `γ` and the quotient by the kernel of `β`.
declarations.statement:
theorem periodicDeterminant_mul (α β γ : M →ₗ[R] M)
    (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) (h : ComplementaryImagesKernels α β γ) :
    periodicDeterminant α (β ∘ₗ γ)
        (exact_alpha_betaGamma α β γ h) (exact_betaGamma_alpha α β γ h) hM =
      periodicDeterminant (alphaOnGammaRange α β γ h)
          (betaOnGammaRange α β γ h)
          (exact_alpha_beta_onGammaRange α β γ h)
          (exact_beta_alpha_onGammaRange α β γ h)
          (hM.of_injective (LinearMap.range γ).subtype_injective) *
        periodicDeterminant (alphaOnKerBetaQuotient α β γ h)
          (gammaOnKerBetaQuotient α β γ h)
          (exact_alpha_gamma_onKerBetaQuotient α β γ h)
          (exact_gamma_alpha_onKerBetaQuotient α β γ h)
          (hM.of_surjective (Submodule.mkQ_surjective (LinearMap.ker β)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.connectingEquivs
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PV.** The two connecting isomorphisms associated to an exact
morphism of two-periodic complexes. The first uses `φ'` then `ψ`, and the second uses `ψ'`
then `φ`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def connectingEquivs
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} {M' : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R M']
    (φ ψ : M →ₗ[R] M) (φ' ψ' : M' →ₗ[R] M') (α : M →ₗ[R] M')
    (hφψ : Function.Exact φ ψ) (hψφ : Function.Exact ψ φ)
    (hφ'ψ' : Function.Exact φ' ψ') (hψ'φ' : Function.Exact ψ' φ')
    (hαφ : α.comp φ = φ'.comp α) (hαψ : α.comp ψ = ψ'.comp α)
    (hKφ : LinearMap.ker α ≤ LinearMap.ker φ)
    (hKψ : LinearMap.ker α ≤ LinearMap.ker ψ)
    (hQφ : LinearMap.range φ' ≤ LinearMap.range α)
    (hQψ : LinearMap.range ψ' ≤ LinearMap.range α) :
    {e : ((M' ⧸ LinearMap.range α) ≃ₗ[R] LinearMap.ker α) ×
        ((M' ⧸ LinearMap.range α) ≃ₗ[R] LinearMap.ker α) //
      (∀ (x' : M') (y : M), α y = φ' x' →
        ((e.1 (Submodule.Quotient.mk x') : LinearMap.ker α) : M) = ψ y) ∧
      (∀ (x' : M') (y : M), α y = ψ' x' →
        ((e.2 (Submodule.Quotient.mk x') : LinearMap.ker α) : M) = φ y)}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.periodicDeterminant_eq_det_connecting_mul
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PV.** The change of periodic determinant is the determinant of the
second connecting isomorphism followed by the inverse of the first.
declarations.statement:
theorem periodicDeterminant_eq_det_connecting_mul
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} {M' : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R M']
    (φ ψ : M →ₗ[R] M) (φ' ψ' : M' →ₗ[R] M') (α : M →ₗ[R] M')
    (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) (hM' : IsFiniteLength R M')
    (hφψ : Function.Exact φ ψ) (hψφ : Function.Exact ψ φ)
    (hφ'ψ' : Function.Exact φ' ψ') (hψ'φ' : Function.Exact ψ' φ')
    (hαφ : α.comp φ = φ'.comp α) (hαψ : α.comp ψ = ψ'.comp α)
    (hKφ : LinearMap.ker α ≤ LinearMap.ker φ)
    (hKψ : LinearMap.ker α ≤ LinearMap.ker ψ)
    (hQφ : LinearMap.range φ' ≤ LinearMap.range α)
    (hQψ : LinearMap.range ψ' ≤ LinearMap.range α) :
    periodicDeterminant φ ψ hφψ hψφ hM =
      determinantAutomorphism
        ((connectingEquivs φ ψ φ' ψ' α hφψ hψφ hφ'ψ' hψ'φ'
          hαφ hαψ hKφ hKψ hQφ hQψ).1.2.trans
          (connectingEquivs φ ψ φ' ψ' α hφψ hψφ hφ'ψ' hψ'φ'
            hαφ hαψ hKφ hKψ hQφ hQψ).1.1.symm)
        (hM'.of_surjective (Submodule.mkQ_surjective (LinearMap.range α))) *
      periodicDeterminant φ' ψ' hφ'ψ' hψ'φ' hM'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.periodicDeterminant_eq_of_connecting_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PV.** Equal connecting isomorphisms give equal periodic
determinants.
declarations.statement:
theorem periodicDeterminant_eq_of_connecting_eq
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} {M' : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R M']
    (φ ψ : M →ₗ[R] M) (φ' ψ' : M' →ₗ[R] M') (α : M →ₗ[R] M')
    (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) (hM' : IsFiniteLength R M')
    (hφψ : Function.Exact φ ψ) (hψφ : Function.Exact ψ φ)
    (hφ'ψ' : Function.Exact φ' ψ') (hψ'φ' : Function.Exact ψ' φ')
    (hαφ : α.comp φ = φ'.comp α) (hαψ : α.comp ψ = ψ'.comp α)
    (hKφ : LinearMap.ker α ≤ LinearMap.ker φ)
    (hKψ : LinearMap.ker α ≤ LinearMap.ker ψ)
    (hQφ : LinearMap.range φ' ≤ LinearMap.range α)
    (hQψ : LinearMap.range ψ' ≤ LinearMap.range α)
    (heq : (connectingEquivs φ ψ φ' ψ' α hφψ hψφ hφ'ψ' hψ'φ'
      hαφ hαψ hKφ hKψ hQφ hQψ).1.1 =
      (connectingEquivs φ ψ φ' ψ' α hφψ hψφ hφ'ψ' hψ'φ'
        hαφ hαψ hKφ hKψ hQφ hQψ).1.2) :
    periodicDeterminant φ ψ hφψ hψφ hM =
      periodicDeterminant φ' ψ' hφ'ψ' hψ'φ' hM'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exact_periodicQuotient_phi_psi
declarations.doc:
On the quotient by the common composite image, the map induced by `φ` is exact before
the map induced by `ψ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_periodicQuotient_phi_psi (φ ψ : M →ₗ[R] M)
    (hψ : Function.Injective ψ)
    (hcomm : LinearMap.range (φ ∘ₗ ψ) = LinearMap.range (ψ ∘ₗ φ)) :
    Function.Exact (periodicQuotientPhi φ ψ hcomm) (periodicQuotientPsi φ ψ hcomm)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exact_periodicQuotient_psi_phi
declarations.doc:
On the quotient by the common composite image, the map induced by `ψ` is exact before
the map induced by `φ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_periodicQuotient_psi_phi (φ ψ : M →ₗ[R] M)
    (hφ : Function.Injective φ)
    (hcomm : LinearMap.range (φ ∘ₗ ψ) = LinearMap.range (ψ ∘ₗ φ)) :
    Function.Exact (periodicQuotientPsi φ ψ hcomm) (periodicQuotientPhi φ ψ hcomm)

declarations.name: Module.isFiniteLength_quotient_range_of_injective
declarations.doc:
The quotient of a finite module of support dimension one by an injective endomorphism has
finite length.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLength_quotient_range_of_injective
    (f : M →ₗ[A] M) (hf : Function.Injective f)

    IsFiniteLength A (M ⧸ LinearMap.range f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFiniteLength_quotient_mul
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 02PY.** The quotient by `abM` has finite length.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLength_quotient_mul [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [Module.Finite A M] (a b : A)
    (ha : IsSMulRegular M a) (hb : IsSMulRegular M b)
    (hdim : Module.supportDim A M = 1) :
    IsFiniteLength A
    (M ⧸ LinearMap.range
        ((LinearMap.lsmul A M a) ∘ₗ (LinearMap.lsmul A M b)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exact_mul_left_right
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PY.** Exactness at the differential induced by multiplication
by `b`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_mul_left_right (a b : A)
    (hb : IsSMulRegular M b) :
    Function.Exact
      (periodicQuotientPhi
        (LinearMap.lsmul A M a) (LinearMap.lsmul A M b)
        (range_lsmul_comp_comm a b))
      (periodicQuotientPsi
        (LinearMap.lsmul A M a) (LinearMap.lsmul A M b)
        (range_lsmul_comp_comm a b))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exact_mul_right_left
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PY.** Exactness at the differential induced by multiplication
by `a`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_mul_right_left (a b : A)
    (ha : IsSMulRegular M a) :
    Function.Exact
      (periodicQuotientPsi
        (LinearMap.lsmul A M a) (LinearMap.lsmul A M b)
        (range_lsmul_comp_comm a b))
      (periodicQuotientPhi
        (LinearMap.lsmul A M a) (LinearMap.lsmul A M b)
        (range_lsmul_comp_comm a b))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFiniteLength_ring_quotient_mul
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PY.** The ring quotient `A/(ab)` has finite length when `A` has

declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLength_ring_quotient_mul

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exact_ring_mul_left_right

declarations.statement:
theorem exact_ring_mul_left_right
    (a b : A) (hb : IsSMulRegular A b) :

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSymbol
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02PZ.** The symbol of a finite module of support dimension one,
evaluated on two elements acting injectively on it.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def moduleSymbol
    {A : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (a b : A) (ha : IsSMulRegular M a) (hb : IsSMulRegular M b)
    (hdim : Module.supportDim A M = 1) : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)ˣ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSymbol_mul_right
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 02Q0.** The symbol is multiplicative in its second argument.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleSymbol_mul_right
    {A : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (a b c : A) (ha : IsSMulRegular M a) (hb : IsSMulRegular M b)
    (hc : IsSMulRegular M c) (hdim : Module.supportDim A M = 1) :
    moduleSymbol a (b * c) ha (hb.mul hc) hdim =
      moduleSymbol a b ha hb hdim * moduleSymbol a c ha hc hdim

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSymbol_mul_swap
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 02Q0.** Swapping the two arguments gives inverse symbols.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleSymbol_mul_swap
    {A : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (a b : A) (ha : IsSMulRegular M a) (hb : IsSMulRegular M b)
    (hdim : Module.supportDim A M = 1) :
    moduleSymbol a b ha hb hdim * moduleSymbol b a hb ha hdim = 1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.tameSymbol
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02Q1.** The tame symbol of a one-dimensional Noetherian local
domain, extended to its fraction field.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def tameSymbol {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] {K : Type v} [Field K]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1) :
    TameSymbol (K := K) hdim

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSymbol_unit_left
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02Q2.** The symbol with a unit in its first argument is the
corresponding power of its residue, with exponent the length of the quotient by the second
argument.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleSymbol_unit_left
    {A : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (u : Aˣ) (b : A) (hb : IsSMulRegular M b)
    (hdim : Module.supportDim A M = 1) :
    moduleSymbol (u : A) b (Units.isSMulRegular M u) hb hdim =
      IsLocalRing.residue A u ^
        moduleLength A (M ⧸ (LinearMap.lsmul A M b).range)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSymbol_unit_left_ring
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02Q2.** For a one-dimensional Noetherian local ring, the exponent in
the unit-symbol formula is the order of vanishing of the second argument.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleSymbol_unit_left_ring
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] (u : Aˣ) (b : A) (hb : IsSMulRegular A b)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1) :
    moduleSymbol (M := A) (u : A) b (Units.isSMulRegular A u) hb
      (by simpa only [Module.supportDim_self_eq_ringKrullDim] using hdim) =
      IsLocalRing.residue A u ^ (Ring.ord A b).toNat

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSymbol_short_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 02Q3.** The symbol of the middle term of a short exact sequence is
the product of the symbols of its outer terms.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleSymbol_short_exact
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {M : Type v₁} {M' : Type v₂} {M'' : Type v₃}
